name: Telegram Social Video Downloader — Public Template

nodes.name: Telegram Webhook
nodes.notes: Configure Telegram with a secret_token and POST updates to this production webhook URL. Requests without the matching header are rejected.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { chat_id: $json.chat_id, text: `⚠️ I couldn't find a supported video link.

Please send a public link from:
• TikTok
• Instagram
• X/Twitter
• Facebook

Tip: paste the full post/reel/video URL 🔗` } }}

nodes.name: Send Unsupported Message
nodes.notes: Sends a Telegram text message through the downloader service; no bot token is stored in n8n.

nodes.name: Queue Download
nodes.notes: Queues the download service. The bot token stays inside the downloader service.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { chat_id: $json.chat_id, text: `👋 Welcome to Social Video Downloader!

Send me a public video link and I’ll fetch it for you.

✅ Supported:
• TikTok
• Instagram Reels/Videos
• X/Twitter videos
• Facebook videos/reels

⚡ Fast background downloads
🎞️ Keeps the right aspect ratio when possible
📩 I’ll reply with the video when it’s ready

Just paste a link to begin 🚀` } }}

nodes.name: Send Welcome Message
nodes.notes: Sends a Telegram text message through the downloader service; no bot token is stored in n8n.
